_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) — setup.sh does that for you. Every key is optional; these are the defaults.

_driveSync.titleContains: Drive title substring to match. 'Notes by Gemini' is what Google names auto-generated meeting notes Docs.
_driveSync.outputDir: Where the markdown lands. One file per Doc, named <created-date>-<slug>.md. Existing files are never overwritten without --force.
_driveSync.lookbackDays: How far back the very first run looks. After that a saved cursor takes over.
_driveSync.maxPerRun: Ceiling on Docs exported in one run, so a first sync of a large Drive cannot run away. Hitting it logs 'WARNING: N Docs queued, capping at 60 this run' and the rest come next run.
_driveSync.exclude: Case-insensitive regex on the Doc title. Anything matching is skipped — e.g. 'orientation|1:1|HR'.
